author: Woifi
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age? 
14 years old
What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
Wolfi#3347
How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
Map making could take me fairly quickly, maybe around a week or two. As long as I am free and focused on the task. If I am doing a partnered task I could get the job done maybe twice as quick. 
What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
Very committed to a task, like to get the job done with my full potential. Have great creativity, love to build structures and maps as a pass time of mine.
Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
Beyond me, I consider a good necessity in order to make a good map for Avicus gameplay is having a well thought out plan and islands have to be big. Also to mention, one of the key factors on a good map is that the void gap has to be a decent size.
How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
No experience with the Avicus XML, but willing to learn on how to fix errors that may occur. 
As a builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
As a builder, personally, I would focus on building maps. As I'm not too frequent with the XML.
How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
No experience with the Avicus XML, but willing to learn on how to fix errors that may occur. 
As a builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
As a builder, personally, I would focus on building maps. As I'm not too frequent with the Avicus  XML.
Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/5d7571669  - Planet, Arcade
https://imgur.com/a/Bs76N  - Claimed Towers, CTW. Able to /sn.  
https://imgur.com/a/qe99g  - No name, CTW. Currently under construction. 
Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
Yes, I am currently building an FFA map with Riilo.
Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
I've always loved building since I first started Minecraft, I've progressed more and more my creative skills and willing to share them with the Avicus community. I would love to participate in making Avicus as great as it can be regarding the map making or any project done for the server.  I would like to offer maps that people enjoy playing and have fun with. If they're happy, I'm happy.
How do you think you will help the map development team? 
Personally, I think I would help the map development team by being very active and quick on task, done with passion and care. I am determined to work, if anyone asks me to do a project, I can get working on it as soon as possible if I am free. I can help if any is needed, help with issues that vary from anything. Also, very willing to learn on how to XML maps for Avicus. 

Thanks for reading, have a good day!
